title: Pokémon TCG Galarian Farfetch'd Sword & Shield Chilling Reign 078/198 Regular
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Pokémon TCG card features the powerful Galarian Farfetch'd, with 80 HP and a single strike speciality. The card is made from high-quality card stock and has a regular finish. It belongs to the Sword & Shield - Chilling Reign set, with card number 078/198. 

This basic stage Pokémon card is perfect for collectors and players alike. It is a standard size card and comes in English language. The card is not autographed and is a common rarity. The character illustration is done by Hyogonosuke and the card is manufactured by The Pokémon Company in the United States.
